title: Canonical Smart Notes + CIS Architecture

source.path: Naya Power Smart Notes architecture discussion

summary: Naya Power memory is a chronological Note Event system with semantic retrieval, paired Naya/Human representations, mandatory verification receipts, and a Compounding Intelligence System that synthesizes learning from daily through lifetime horizons.
what_happened: The existing Smart Notes organization was identified as too flat and fragmented. The architecture was corrected so time is the primary memory structure, meaning is the retrieval layer, and Naya/Human notes are representations of shared events.
what_we_learned: A flat pile of Naya Notes, Shawn Notes, and Smart Notes is an information-architecture failure, not merely a naming problem.
The canonical object should be a Note Event with a shared event_id and timestamp.
Chronology should organize memory as YEAR → MONTH → DAY → HOUR → EVENT.
Semantic metadata, aliases, relationships, provenance, and evidence make the memory retrievable by meaning as well as time.
Every Smart Note needs a verification receipt so completion is observable rather than assumed.
Daily Intelligence Reports turn captured events into reflection and growth; CIS compounds that intelligence into weekly, monthly, quarterly, six-month, annual, and lifetime understanding.
why_it_matters: This turns Naya Power from a filing system into a durable compounding intelligence system that different AI models and sessions can restore, understand, verify, retrieve, and build upon.
what_changed: Created the canonical Smart Notes + CIS Constitution.
Established Note Event as the fundamental memory object.
Established chronological primary organization and semantic retrieval as complementary layers.
Established mandatory Smart Note verification and receipt law.
Extended the Smart Note schema for event identity, representation, verification, and time buckets.
Made the architecture part of the canonical memory bootstrap.
next_best_action: Implement the runtime/index support that materializes chronological event buckets, verification receipts, feed receipts, and Daily Intelligence Reports while preserving existing memory history.
content: Core law: TIME ORGANIZES MEMORY. MEANING CONNECTS MEMORY. INDEXING RETRIEVES MEMORY. Smart Notes preserve learning; CIS compounds learning. The AI must not merely save a note; it must validate it, verify it, issue a durable receipt, and make it retrievable.

evidence: File was created in the canonical repository and fetched successfully afterward.
The event_id, timestamp, representation, required Smart Note fields, canonical URL, and time bucket are present.
INDEX.json contains this note and maps it to the shared event.
Canonical Smart Notes + CIS Constitution committed to main.
Memory bootstrap updated to require the new architecture.
Smart Note schema extended for event identity and verification.
